Usage: SeleniumToPlayWright <path-to-.csproj> [options]

Rewrites the project's Selenium code to Playwright with a Roslyn rewriter.

  --dry-run                 Report what would change without writing any file.
  --keep-project-file       Leave the .csproj package references alone.
  --playwright-version <v>  Version used when adding Microsoft.Playwright.
  --help                    Show this help.
